findings.title: Preference-disable tests cannot detect omitted provider logout
findings.scenario: Provider logout becomes a no-op when OPTIONAL MFA is disabled.
findings.expected: An existing provider refresh token is rejected after disable.
findings.actual: The disable test checks synthetic application-session row deletion with provider administration unconfigured. Real refresh rejection covers administrative reset only.
findings.evidence: MfaPolicyIntegrationTest.java:292–298; MfaResetIntegrationTest.java:136. Static coverage finding, not an observed logout failure.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable MFA with configured provider administration, then reuse the old refresh token and application cookie.
findings.repro_test: A no-op mutation of preference-disable provider logout must fail the integration test.
